messages:
Maya (Product): Short sync 10min: need to lock scope for the tenant-prefetch pilot. Customer wants burst windows, on-demand HSM, and deterministic fallbacks. Who owns sequencing + gating?
Jin (Eng): We can implement burst routing but runtime needs async batcher + KV cache policy tuning. Priya/Alex/Sam: rough estimates?
Priya (Runtime): Async batcher + KV policy toggles ~2 sprints for stability (2 engs). Need a synthetic harness for long-tail sequences and pinned model flags for graceful fallback.
Alex (Infra): Canary/dedicated burst pool possible. Work: reserve capacity, autoscale policy, VPC routing for HSM traffic. Estimate ~7 dev-days incl tests. Need sustained vs burst QPS to size.
Sam (Security): HSM options: cloud KMS with HSM-backed keys (faster) or customer on-prem HSM (adds compliance + DMZ). I'll draft threat model and checklist; external auditor availability may be a blocker.
Ivy (Solutions): Customer wants explicit pilot SLO and a short SLA blurb for sales. We should define error modes and what fallback messaging looks like.
Maya (Product): Proposed launch gates: 1) customer acceptance tests green; 2) p50 <=150ms for 512 tokens on dedicated pool; 3) automated fallback to hosted-compatible model variant; 4) security signoff for keys; 5) perf-regression CI gate. Additions?
Jin (Eng): Add chaos test that simulates pool outage to validate fallback. Also document quantization vs quality tradeoffs in the spec.
Priya (Runtime): We'll add canary routing and per-tenant model-pin flag. Request a small canary slice from infra for staged rollout testing.
Alex (Infra): Opening INFRA ticket and reserving slot. Action item: product -> expected sustained RPS and burst QPS by EOD so we can size the pool.
deploy-bot: INFRA-8123 created: reserved window 2024-10-05..2024-10-15 for canary testing
Sam (Security): If HSM review slips, fallback: customer-managed KMS + full audit logs + runtime key rotation. I'll post checklist and required approvals.
Maya (Product): Action recap: Jin -> perf test + CI PR; Priya -> runtime fallback + test matrix; Alex -> infra ticket + autoscale runbook; Sam -> HSM checklist; Ivy -> customer comms draft. Will update roadmap card and share deck.
Jin (Eng): Local perf repro: `./run_perf --model tenant-prefetch-v1 --tokens 512 --concurrency 8 --duration 60s`
Ivy (Solutions): I'll draft the SLO blurb and minimal SLA text for sales to use in customer comms.
Priya (Runtime): Note: runtime tests should include one quantized and one FP16 variant to measure latency vs quality delta.
Alex (Infra): Sending RPS ask now. DM me for early access to canary pool.
Maya (Product): Thanks all. Reconvene Tue 11am unless blockers.
